ui.title: Fill your
ui.intro: Two collections, your own preferences. Pick a color, fill your jars, and save your picture.
ui.nameHint: Nickname is fine, or leave it blank. It appears on your picture.
ui.fillHint: 0 is empty, 5 is full. Tap 5 again for more overflow, up to the biggest spill. A lower number resets the overflow. Tap 1–4 again to empty.
ui.adultNote: Kink terms refer to consenting adults. Preferences are personal; a rating is never consent.
ui.privacy: Your answers stay in this browser.
ui.legend: 0 = empty · 5 = full · tap 5 again = more overflow
ui.resetConfirm: Empty all {mode} jars? Your other collection will stay as it is.
ui.modalHint: If the download didn't start, press and hold the picture (or right-click) and choose Save image.
ui.storageError: This browser cannot save your progress. You can still fill your jars and download your picture.
ui.saveError: The picture could not be created. Please try again.
